query: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.status, g.id as grid_id, g.version, g.rows, g.cols, g.totalPanels, LEFT(g.gridImageUrl, 80) as grid_url FROM projects p LEFT JOIN grids g ON p.id = g.projectId ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 10;
